title: "6 - Analyze features"
params:
  lang: "de_en"      # de_en (main), de (SI)
  controls: "none"   # none (main), activity (SI: + log number of classified tweets)
  disgust: false     # false (main), true (robustness check for the response letter)
---

<!--
Task:   Feature distributions, PCA and the results of the bootstrapped regressions.
Input:  data/Austria-Panel-Users-Features-Tweet-<lang>.csv
        output/users/user_models_tweet_boot_<lang>*.rds (from 5-boot_features_models.R)
Output: output/tables/user_table.tex, table_{news,misinfo,partisan}_models.tex
        output/figures/features_hist.pdf, pca_scree_plot.pdf
        output/users/*.png
Run:    As R Markdown or in terminal as Rscript -e 'rmarkdown::render("6-analyze_features.Rmd")'   # variants: params = list(lang = "de", controls = "activity", disgust = TRUE)
-->

```{r}
rm(list = setdiff(ls(), "params"))   # keep the render parameters

library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
library(corrplot)
library(car)
library(FactoMineR)
library(factoextra)
library(boot)
library(pROC)
library(kableExtra)

# variant via render(params = list(...)), see the YAML header; defaults = main specification
LANG     <- params$lang       # de_en (main), de (SI)
CONTROLS <- params$controls   # none (main), activity (SI: + log number of classified tweets)
DISGUST  <- params$disgust    # FALSE (main), TRUE (robustness: + disgust; validation failed)
EMOTIONS <- c("anger", "fear", if (DISGUST) "disgust")
FEATURES <- c("baseline", "variability", "instability", "inertia")
tag <- paste0(if (LANG == "de_en") "" else paste0("_", LANG),
              if (CONTROLS == "activity") "_activity" else "",
              if (DISGUST) "_disgust" else "")

src <- "../../data"
dst <- "../../output"
users_dir <- file.path(dst, "users")
for (d in c(users_dir, file.path(dst, "figures"), file.path(dst, "tables"))) {
  dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
}
file <- paste0("Austria-Panel-Users-Features-Tweet-", LANG, ".csv")
features <- read_csv(file.path(src, file),
                     col_types = cols(
                       author_id = col_character(),
                       .default = col_double()
                     ))
emotion_vars <- as.vector(outer(EMOTIONS, FEATURES, paste, sep = "_"))
```


```{r}
custom_plot <- function() {
  theme_classic() +  
    theme(
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 11),
      axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 11),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.text  = element_text(size = 11)
    )
}
```

# ===== DISTRIBUTION PLOTS =====
```{r}
corr_features <- features %>%
  dplyr:::select(-author_id)

dist_data <- corr_features %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "feature", values_to = "value")

# remove avg_untrustworthy and avg_biased
pred_data <- dist_data %>%
  filter(feature != "n_news_shared" & feature != "n_untrustworthy_shared" & feature != "n_biased_shared") %>%
  # only the emotions analyzed (no disgust in the main specification)
  filter(!grepl("^(anger|fear|disgust)_", feature) |
         grepl(paste0("^(", paste(EMOTIONS, collapse = "|"), ")_"), feature))

dist_plot <- ggplot(pred_data, aes(x = value)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.9) +
  facet_wrap(~ feature, scales = "free", ncol = 4) +
  scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 3,  # fewer breaks so that the labels do not overlap
                     labels = scales::label_number(drop0trailing = TRUE, scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale())) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(big.mark = ",")) +
  labs(x = "value",
       y = "frequency") +
  custom_plot() +
  theme(
     axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 8),
     axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8)
        )

ggsave(paste0(users_dir, "/features_hist", tag, ".png"), 
          dist_plot, 
          width = 6.5, height = 4)
print(dist_plot)
```

# ===== MODEL EVALUATION =====

```{r}
features$log_n_scored <- log(features$n_scored)
complete_features <- features[complete.cases(features[,
                        c('shares_untrustworthy', 'shares_news', 'shares_biased',
                          emotion_vars)]), ]  # features can be NaN if not enough data points

df <- complete_features %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(c(emotion_vars, "log_n_scored")), ~ as.numeric(scale(.))))

# whats the number of users?
nrow(df)
```

```{r}
# one model per outcome and feature type: outcome ~ anger + fear [+ disgust] (z-standardized)
fit_feature_model <- function(outcome, feature) {
  rhs <- paste(EMOTIONS, feature, sep = "_")
  if (CONTROLS == "activity") rhs <- c(rhs, "log_n_scored")
  glm(reformulate(rhs, outcome), data = df, family = binomial)
}
outcomes <- c(news = "shares_news", misinfo = "shares_untrustworthy", partisan = "shares_biased")
models <- lapply(outcomes, function(o) setNames(lapply(FEATURES, function(f) fit_feature_model(o, f)),
                                              FEATURES))
lapply(models, function(ms) lapply(ms, vif))
lapply(models, function(ms) sapply(ms, function(m) round(exp(coef(m))[-1], 2)))
```



# ===== ADD BOOTSTRAP UNCERTAINTY =====
```{r}
boot_objects <- readRDS(paste0(users_dir, "/user_models_tweet_boot_", LANG,
                               if (CONTROLS == "activity") "_activity" else "",
                               if (DISGUST) "_disgust" else "", ".rds"))

boot_news_base <- boot_objects$boot_news_base
boot_news_var <- boot_objects$boot_news_var
boot_news_inst <- boot_objects$boot_news_inst
boot_news_inertia <- boot_objects$boot_news_inertia
boot_misinfo_base <- boot_objects$boot_misinfo_base
boot_misinfo_var <- boot_objects$boot_misinfo_var
boot_misinfo_inst <- boot_objects$boot_misinfo_inst
boot_misinfo_inertia <- boot_objects$boot_misinfo_inertia
boot_partisan_base <- boot_objects$boot_partisan_base
boot_partisan_var <- boot_objects$boot_partisan_var
boot_partisan_inst <- boot_objects$boot_partisan_inst
boot_partisan_inertia <- boot_objects$boot_partisan_inertia
```

```{r}
get_boot_cis <- function(boot_obj, outcome_name, feature_name) {
  param_names <- names(boot_obj$t0)
  param_names <- param_names[!param_names %in% c("(Intercept)", "log_n_scored")] # skip intercept and control
  indices <- which(names(boot_obj$t0) %in% param_names)
  
  ci_df <- data.frame(
    outcome = outcome_name,
    feature = feature_name,
    parameter = param_names,
    estimate = boot_obj$t0[indices],
    lower = apply(boot_obj$t[, indices, drop=FALSE], 2, quantile, probs = 0.025),
    upper = apply(boot_obj$t[, indices, drop=FALSE], 2, quantile, probs = 0.975)
  )
  
  rownames(ci_df) <- NULL
  return(ci_df)
}


boot_results <- bind_rows(
  get_boot_cis(boot_news_base, "any news", "baseline"),
  get_boot_cis(boot_news_var, "any news", "variability"),
  get_boot_cis(boot_news_inst, "any news", "instability"),
  get_boot_cis(boot_news_inertia, "any news", "inertia"),
  
  get_boot_cis(boot_misinfo_base, "untrustworthy news", "baseline"),
  get_boot_cis(boot_misinfo_var, "untrustworthy news", "variability"),
  get_boot_cis(boot_misinfo_inst, "untrustworthy news", "instability"),
  get_boot_cis(boot_misinfo_inertia, "untrustworthy news", "inertia"),
  
  get_boot_cis(boot_partisan_base, "partisan news", "baseline"),
  get_boot_cis(boot_partisan_var, "partisan news", "variability"),
  get_boot_cis(boot_partisan_inst, "partisan news", "instability"),
  get_boot_cis(boot_partisan_inertia, "partisan news", "inertia")
)
```

```{r}
# stargazer wont work on one of the models so we create our own function
create_latex_table <- function(models, model_names, filename) {

  # extract coefficients
  coefs <- lapply(models, function(m) {
    summ <- summary(m)$coefficients
    data.frame(
      est = summ[, "Estimate"],
      se = summ[, "Std. Error"],
      pval = summ[, "Pr(>|z|)"],
      term = rownames(summ)
    )
  })

  # add sig. stars
  get_stars <- function(p) {
    if (p < 0.001) return("***")
    if (p < 0.01) return("**")
    if (p < 0.05) return("*")
    return("")
  }

  latex <- ""
  latex <- paste0(latex, "\\begin{tabular}{l", paste(rep("c", length(models)), collapse=""), "}\n")
  latex <- paste0(latex, "\\hline\n")

  latex <- paste0(latex, " & ", paste(model_names, collapse = " & "), " \\\\\n")
  latex <- paste0(latex, "\\hline\n")


  terms <- c(EMOTIONS, if (CONTROLS == "activity") "log_n_scored")
  term_labels <- c(anger = "Anger", fear = "Fear", disgust = "Disgust",
                   log_n_scored = "Log classified tweets")
  for (term in terms) {
    latex <- paste0(latex, term_labels[[term]])
    for (i in 1:length(models)) {
      coef_row <- coefs[[i]][grep(term, coefs[[i]]$term, ignore.case = TRUE), ]
      if (nrow(coef_row) > 0) {
        stars <- get_stars(coef_row$pval)
        latex <- paste0(latex, " & ", sprintf("%.3f", coef_row$est), stars,
                        " (", sprintf("%.3f", coef_row$se), ")")
      } else {
        latex <- paste0(latex, " & ")
      }
    }
    latex <- paste0(latex, " \\\\\n")
  }

  latex <- paste0(latex, "Constant")
  for (i in 1:length(models)) {
    int_row <- coefs[[i]][coefs[[i]]$term == "(Intercept)", ]
    stars <- get_stars(int_row$pval)
    latex <- paste0(latex, " & ", sprintf("%.3f", int_row$est), stars,
                    " (", sprintf("%.3f", int_row$se), ")")
  }
  latex <- paste0(latex, " \\\\\n")

  latex <- paste0(latex, "\\hline\n")

  latex <- paste0(latex, "Observations")
  for (m in models) {
    latex <- paste0(latex, " & ", format(nobs(m), big.mark=","))
  }
  latex <- paste0(latex, " \\\\\n")

  latex <- paste0(latex, "AIC")
  for (m in models) {
    latex <- paste0(latex, " & ", sprintf("%.1f", AIC(m)))
  }
  latex <- paste0(latex, " \\\\\n")

  latex <- paste0(latex, "\\hline\n")
  latex <- paste0(latex, "\\multicolumn{", length(models)+1, "}{l}{\\footnotesize $^{***}$p$<$0.001; $^{**}$p$<$0.01; $^{*}$p$<$0.05} \\\\\n")
  latex <- paste0(latex, "\\end{tabular}\n")

  writeLines(latex, file.path(dst, "tables", sub("\\.tex$", paste0(tag, ".tex"), filename)))
  cat("LaTeX table written to", filename, "\n")
}


for (o in names(outcomes)) {
  create_latex_table(models[[o]], c("Baseline", "Variability", "Instability", "Inertia"),
                     paste0("table_", o, "_models.tex"))
}
```
